description: This file defines macros, inline functions, and constants for CPU register access and control on a PowerPC architecture, including SPR register manipulation, MSR register handling, and cache control functions. It is part of the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform.

methods.name: get_msr
methods.description: Inline function to read the Machine State Register (MSR) on PowerPC.

methods.name: set_msr
methods.description: Inline function to write to the Machine State Register (MSR) on PowerPC.

methods.name: get_spr
methods.description: Inline macro to read a special-purpose register (SPR) by number.

methods.name: set_spr
methods.description: Inline macro to write a value to a specific SPR by number.

methods.name: cntlzw
methods.description: Function to count leading zeros in an unsigned int.

methods.name: ilog2
methods.description: Function to compute integer log base 2 of a value.

methods.name: in_user_mode
methods.description: Checks if the CPU is in user mode based on MSR.

methods.name: to_user_mode
methods.description: Switches CPU to user mode by clearing MSR_PR bit.
